# ml-service-template (ML-MLOps Production Template)

> Agent-driven template for production ML systems.
> Version: v0.27.0 | License: Apache-2.0 | Author: DuqueOM

## What this is
A complete, opinionated MLOps template for shipping classical ML models to
production across two clouds (GKE + EKS), with an agentic operating model,
governed CI/CD, and 38 encoded anti-patterns (D-01 to D-38). Every non-trivial
decision is captured in an ADR with measured trade-offs.
Scope: classical ML (scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM). LLM/GenAI *serving* is
out of scope (lives in the sibling `agent-local` repo); LLM-*assisted* ops are
governed by ADR-028.

> Versioning: the active public line is `v0.x` hardening. Tags `v1.0.0`–`v1.12.0`
> remain immutable historical audit snapshots; `v1.0.0` is reserved for the first
> real cloud E2E validation across GKE and EKS. Single source of truth = `VERSION`;
> coherence across docs is enforced by `scripts/check_doc_coherence.py` (rule 16).

## Key files
- AGENTS.md: canonical constitution — anti-patterns D-01→D-38, invariants, agent/skill/workflow index
- CLAUDE.md: Claude Code project context (stack, invariants, file structure)
- QUICK_START.md: 10-minute onboarding (example, scaffold, MLflow)
- RUNBOOK.md / docs/RELEASING.md: operations + versioning policy
- CHANGELOG.md: full version history (Keep a Changelog + SemVer)
- docs/decisions/: 43 ADR files (ADR-001 → ADR-043; ADR-012 is an immutable tombstone)

## Agentic system (canonical store: `agentic/`, ADR-027)
- agentic/rules/ — 19 path-scoped behavioral rules (incl. 16-doc-coherence, 17-edge-protection, 18-audit-quality)
- agentic/skills/ — 27 operational procedures (deploy-gke/aws, drift, retrain,
  release-checklist, rule-audit, edge-audit, enterprise-audit, security-audit, scaffold-update, doc-coherence,
  stack-switch, template-onboard, …)
- agentic/workflows/ — 20 slash-command workflows (/new-service, /retrain,
  /incident, /drift-check, /release, /new-adr, /doc-coherence, /stack-switch,
  /edge-setup, /onboard, /audit-quality, /document-changes, …)
- Surfaces (generated, ADR-027): `.claude/` `.cursor/` `.codex/` thin pointers;
  `.devin/` full-body mirror. `scripts/sync_agentic_adapters.py` renders them;
  `--check` enforces byte-parity in CI.
- Behavior protocol: AUTO / CONSULT / STOP per the Agent Permissions Matrix.

## Template structure
- templates/service/ — FastAPI async serving + training + monitoring + fairness + DVC
- templates/k8s/ — base/ + 6 env×cloud overlays (gcp/aws × dev/staging/prod) with PSS
- templates/service/infra/terraform/ — GCP (GKE + Workload Identity) + AWS (EKS + IRSA), per-env state
- templates/service/.github/workflows/ — GitHub Actions: build → digest-pin → Cosign sign+attest → Kyverno verify
- templates/service/common_utils/ — seed, logging, model_persistence, agent_context, risk_context, memory_*
- examples/minimal/ — working fraud detection: train → serve → test → drift

## Key invariants (never violate)
- uvicorn --workers 1 only (HPA scales horizontally; CPU-only HPA for ML pods)
- CPU-bound inference via run_in_executor(ThreadPoolExecutor) — never block the event loop
- KernelExplainer SHAP in ORIGINAL feature space
- No model artifacts in Docker images (init container + emptyDir)
- DIR >= 0.80 fairness gate before every model promotion
- IRSA (AWS) / Workload Identity (GCP) — no static credentials
- `~=` ML package pinning (numpy 2.x corrupts joblib models)

## Releases
Active line: v0.27.0 (latest). Historical audit snapshots: v1.0.0 → v1.12.0 (immutable).
